## Changes

### Added
- Drag along the reader's page meter to jump straight to a page.
- Hero animation setting (More → Appearance): the cover flying into a comic's details is now off by default.

### Changed
- More is shorter: Sources, Library, Translation, Backup and Appearance each open their own screen; Sync and About stay on More.
- Page translation stays on when you go to another chapter from the reader, and turns off when you leave the reader.

### Fixed
- In the vertical reader, a speech balloon cut where one page image ends and the next begins is now translated whole instead of in two half-translated pieces.
- Fast scrolling no longer stutters or flashes blank pages that were already loaded.
- Screens with a back button have some space under their top bar.
